title: Lie dimension equals local dimension at a smooth identity
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $G$ a smooth $k$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme]. Let $e\in G$ be the image of the unique point of $\operatorname{Spec}k$ under its identity section. For the Lie algebra $\operatorname{Lie}(G)$ [def-wf-lie-algebra-derivation], $\dim_k\operatorname{Lie}(G)=\dim\mathcal O_{G,e}$. Dimensions are interpreted in $\{-\infty,0,1,\ldots,\infty\}$, with the left side the cast of its finite vector-space dimension.

source.place: Dimension paragraph; sk-i-cartier third proof paragraph

proof.text: Apply the cotangent-dual identification at the rational identity, obtaining a ring isomorphism r from k to the residue field and a semilinear equivalence E from Lie G to the residue-field dual of its cotangent space. rank_eq_of_equiv_equiv, followed by Cardinal.toNat, identifies their finranks. Subspace.dual_finrank_eq identifies the dual finrank with the cotangent finrank.

Use the proved source-library theorem Smooth.isRegularLocalRing_stalk for the local ring at the identity. Apply Mathlib IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace to identify the cotangent finrank with ringKrullDim. Combining these equalities proves the assertion with no extra hypotheses.

proof_origin.note: Regularity is supplied by the proved source-library scheme-stalk theorem; the Lie/cotangent interface is split off without a smoothness hypothesis.
